params.name: min_time
params.description: The minimum (non-inclusive) timestamp of a disclosure (RFC 3339 format).

params.name: max_time
params.description: The maximum (non-inclusive) timestamp of a disclosure (RFC 3339 format).

params.name: statuses
params.description: A comma-delimited list of statuses that disclosures should match.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma-delimited list of IDs that disclosures should match.

items.docs:
Returns a list of the disclosures in your account matching the given filters.

Required API key permissions: `DataLeaks` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

info.name: Update the status of a disclosure

params.name: new_status
params.description: The new status for the disclosure

params.name: user_email
params.description: The email address of the user changing the status (must have a Cyber Risk account with the "Data Leaks" role).

params.name: comment
params.description: A comment to accompany the status change, if required

items.docs: Required API key permissions: `DataLeaks` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
